overall_rationale: Both must-level pollutant and traffic needs are not yet met in a usable form. N1 has no usable source for the prototype window: the only public hourly pollutant candidate (UCI 360) is rejected for a metadata contradiction, stale data and partial window coverage, and the Chicago link is unreachable and unlicensed. N1 in production rests on internal station data that is access-restricted, with a catalog/wiki conflict on VR-03. N2 (must, production) has no counter-to-station link and an unadjusted 2024 series break. N3 is met with conditions via Open-Meteo, and N4 is met with conditions via the clinic daily counts. N5 and N6 are unmet, but both are could-priority. Because N1 is unmet for the prototype window and N2 has no station join, the use case is not feasible as specified; it could move to feasible_with_conditions for a production-only scope once the internal access, station mapping and Legal sign-off conditions are cleared.

need_coverage.gap: Prototype window (2004-03-10 to 2005-04-04) has no usable pollutant source: UCI 360 is rejected for metadata contradiction and stale data, and station readings start 2023-01-01. Production depends on access and VR-03 reconciliation.
Traffic counts exist for production but have no counter-to-station mapping and an undocumented 2024-03-18 series break, so the link to N1 is unproven.
Reanalysis grid, not station data, with client site coordinates unknown; production needs Legal sign-off and C3S terms are unread. UCI 360 also has T and RH for prototype but is rejected.
Access, legal-basis confirmation, respiratory definition, district code list and suppression rule are all undocumented.
Patient-level table clinic.patient_visits is prohibited for this analysis by the clinic data policy; no other source offers patient-level visits.
Eurostat cube is rejected for unknown licence, covers only 2005-2023 (no production window), and has an undocumented rate unit.
